description: Manages global user settings, preferences, filters, and provides a system-wide intelligent search functionality across all entities.

endpoints.name: GetUserPreferences
endpoints.description: Retrieves user-specific preferences and settings for interface customization and default behaviors.

id.description: User ID to get preferences for

example_uses: Get my user preferences and settings
Get default language and timezone settings
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks for their preferences, settings, customizations, or when loading user interface defaults.

endpoints.name: UpdateUserPreferences
endpoints.description: Updates user-specific preferences and settings for interface customization and default behaviors.

id.description: User ID to update preferences for

userPreferences.description: Updated user preference object containing new settings

example_uses: Update my language preference to French
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to update their preferences, settings, or interface customizations.

endpoints.name: GetGlobalFilters
endpoints.description: Retrieves user's global filter settings and preferences for consistent filtering across all views.

id.description: User ID to get global filters for

example_uses: Retrieve default filters for all pages
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when loading user's saved filter settings or when applying consistent filters across multiple views.

endpoints.name: UpdateGlobalFilters
endpoints.description: Updates user's global filter settings and preferences for consistent filtering across all views.

id.description: User ID to update global filters for

example_uses: Save my default organizational unit filter
Set default status filters for all views
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to save filter preferences that apply across all views and pages.

endpoints.name: ResetGlobalFilters
endpoints.description: Resets user's global filter settings to system defaults, clearing all custom filter preferences.

id.description: User ID to reset global filters for

example_uses: Reset my filter settings to defaults
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to clear their saved filter preferences and return to system defaults.

endpoints.name: GetPreferredLanguage
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current user's preferred language setting for interface localization.
example_uses: What language is my interface set to?
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when loading interface language settings or when determining localization preferences.

endpoints.name: UpdatePreferredLanguage
endpoints.description: Updates the current user's preferred language setting for interface localization.

language.description: Language code to set as preferred (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'es')

example_uses: Update my language preference to English
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to change their interface language or localization preferences.

endpoints.name: IntelligentGlobalSearch
endpoints.description: Performs intelligent global search across all entities using hybrid text and semantic search capabilities. Automatically determines optimal search strategy based on query characteristics and complexity.

debug.description: Enable debug mode to show search strategy and scoring details (default: false)

fullResults.description: Return full detailed results instead of summary (default: false)

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user performs any search operation across the system - it automatically chooses between text search for exact matches and semantic search for conceptual queries.
